text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. In supervised learning, a model learns from training data that includes correct answers. For example, if we show a computer many pictures of cats and dogs with labels, it can learn to tell them apart. During training, the model finds patterns in the data. After that, it can make predictions about new, unseen examples. The accuracy of these predictions shows how well the model has learned. Better training data usually leads to more accurate results, so choosing good data is very important.
